articles.abstract_en: Despite infrastructure's importance to the US economy, evidence on its cost trajectory over time is sparse. We document real spending per new mile over the history of the Interstate Highway System. We find that spending per mile increased more than threefold from the 1960s to the 1980s. This increase persists even conditional on pre-existing observable geographic cost determinants. We then provide suggestive evidence on why. Input prices explain little of the increase. Statistically, changes in income and housing prices explain about half of the increase. We find suggestive evidence that the rise of “citizen voice” in government decision-making increased spending per mile. (JEL D72, H54, N42, N72, R31, R42)
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管基础设施对美国经济至关重要，但关于其成本随时间变化的证据却很少。我们记录了州际公路系统历史上每新增一英里的实际支出。我们发现，从1960年到1980年，每英里的支出增加了三倍多。即使控制了先前存在的地理成本决定因素，这种增加仍然存在。然后，我们提供了关于原因的建议性证据。投入品价格只能解释一小部分增长。统计上，收入和房价的变化解释了大约一半的增长。我们发现建议性证据表明，政府决策中“公民声音”的兴起增加了每英里的支出。(JEL D72, H54, N42, N72, R31, R42)

articles.title_en: Discriminatory Lending: Evidence from Bankers in the Lab
articles.title_cn: 歧视性贷款：来自实验室银行家的证据
articles.abstract_en: We implement a lab-in-the-field experiment with 334 Turkish loan officers to document gender discrimination in small business lending and unpack mechanisms. Officers review multiple real-life loan applications in which we randomize applicant gender. While unconditional approval rates are the same, officers are 26 percent more likely to require a guarantor when we present the same application as coming from a female instead of a male entrepreneur. A causal forest algorithm to estimate heterogeneous treatment effects reveals that discrimination is concentrated among young, inexperienced, and gender-biased officers. Discrimination mainly affects female loan applicants in male-dominated industries, indicating how financial frictions can perpetuate entrepreneurial gender segregation across sectors. (JEL C93, G21, G32, J16, L25, L26, O16)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们与334名土耳其信贷员进行了一项实地实验室实验，以记录小企业贷款中的性别歧视并揭示其机制。信贷员审查多份真实的贷款申请，我们在其中随机化申请人的性别。虽然无条件批准率相同，但当我们将同一份申请呈现为来自女性而非男性企业家时，信贷员要求担保人的可能性高出26%。用于估计异质性处理效应的因果森林算法显示，歧视集中在年轻、缺乏经验且有性别偏见的信贷员中。歧视主要影响男性主导行业中的女性贷款申请人，表明金融摩擦如何能够加剧跨部门的创业性别隔离。(JEL C93, G21, G32, J16, L25, L26, O16)

articles.title_en: Income Segregation and the Rise of the Knowledge Economy
articles.title_cn: 收入隔离与知识经济的崛起
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the effect of an increase in knowledge-intensive activities on spatial inequality in US cities. We leverage a predetermined network of patent citations to instrument for local innovation trends. Between 1990 and 2010, a one-standard-deviation increase in patent growth increases income segregation by 0.65 Gini points, corresponding to 0.31 standard deviations of the over-time change in income segregation. This effect mainly arises from the sorting of residents by income, occupation, and education. Local shocks to innovation induce a clustering of knowledge-intensive jobs and residents, amplified by the response of rents and amenities. (JEL D31, O31, O33, O34, R23, R32)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了知识密集型活动增加对美国城市空间不平等的影响。我们利用预先确定的专利引用网络来为地方创新趋势提供工具变量。在1990年至2010年间，专利增长一个标准差增加会使收入隔离增加0.65个基尼点，相当于收入隔离随时间变化的0.31个标准差。这一效应主要源于居民按收入、职业和教育的分类。地方创新冲击引发知识密集型工作和居民的聚集，并因租金和便利设施的反应而放大。(JEL D31, O31, O33, O34, R23, R32)

articles.title_en: Do Thank-You Calls Increase Charitable Giving? Expert Forecasts and Field Experimental Evidence
articles.title_cn: 感谢电话能增加慈善捐赠吗？专家预测与实地实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Calling to thank donors is considered a key fundraising strategy in the charitable giving industry. Yet the effectiveness of thank-you calls remains untested. We conduct field experiments with public television stations and a national nonprofit in which 500,000 new donors were randomized to receive a thank-you call or not. Fundraising professionals predicted that the calls—which followed standard practices in the industry—would increase donor retention by 80 percent. In stark contrast, we found a precisely estimated null effect of calls on donor retention. (JEL C83, C93, D64, D91, L31, L82)
articles.abstract_cn: 致电感谢捐赠者被认为是慈善捐赠行业中的一项关键筹款策略。然而，感谢电话的有效性尚未经过检验。我们与公共电视台和一个全国性非营利组织进行了实地实验，其中500,000名新捐赠者被随机分配接受感谢电话或不接受。筹款专业人士预测，这些遵循行业标准做法的电话将使捐赠者保留率提高80%。与此形成鲜明对比的是，我们发现电话对捐赠者保留率的影响为零，且估计精确。（JEL C83, C93, D64, D91, L31, L82）

articles.title_en: DETER-ing Deforestation in the Amazon: Environmental Monitoring and Law Enforcement
articles.title_cn: 遏制亚马逊森林砍伐：环境监测与执法
articles.abstract_en: We study Brazil's recent use of satellite technology to overcome law enforcement shortcomings resulting from weak institutional environments. DETER is a system that processes satellite imagery and issues near-real-time deforestation alerts to target environmental enforcement in the Amazon. We propose a novel instrumental variable approach for estimating enforcement's impact on deforestation. Clouds limiting DETER's capacity to detect clearings serve as a source of exogenous variation for the presence of environmental authorities. Findings indicate that monitoring and enforcement effectively curb deforestation. Results hold across several robustness checks. (JEL K32, K42, O13, Q23, Q28, Q54, Q58)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了巴西近期利用卫星技术来克服因制度环境薄弱而导致的执法不足问题。DETER是一个处理卫星图像并发布近实时森林砍伐警报以指导亚马逊地区环境执法的系统。我们提出了一种新颖的工具变量方法来估计执法对森林砍伐的影响。云层限制了DETER检测林间空地的能力，这为环境部门的存在提供了外生变异来源。研究结果表明，监测和执法有效遏制了森林砍伐。这一结果在多项稳健性检验中均成立。(JEL K32, K42, O13, Q23, Q28, Q54, Q58)

articles.title_en: Pay Transparency and the Gender Gap
articles.abstract_en: We examine the impact of public sector salary disclosure laws on university faculty salaries in Canada. The laws, which enable public access to the salaries of individual faculty if they exceed specified thresholds, were introduced in different provinces at different times. Using detailed administrative data covering the majority of faculty in Canada, and an event-study research design that exploits within-province variation in exposure to the policy across institutions and academic departments, we find robust evidence that the laws reduced the gender pay gap between men and women by approximately 20–40 percent. (JEL I23, J16, J31, J44, K31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了公共部门薪酬披露法律对加拿大大学教师薪酬的影响。这些法律允许公众获取超过特定门槛的个别教师的薪酬信息，并在不同省份的不同时间引入。利用覆盖加拿大大多数教师的详细行政数据，以及利用省内机构与学术部门间政策暴露差异的事件研究设计，我们发现强有力的证据表明，这些法律将男女之间的性别薪酬差距缩小了约20-40%。（JEL I23, J16, J31, J44, K31）

articles.title_en: Natural Resource Booms, Human Capital, and Earnings: Evidence from Linked Education and Employment Records
articles.title_cn: 自然资源繁荣、人力资本与收入：来自教育与就业关联记录的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using administrative panel data on the universe of Texas public school students, I analyze how shocks to local economic conditions affect education and employment decisions. I find that high school students at the bottom of the academic ability distribution worked and earned more in response to the fracking boom and that these earnings gains persisted through ages 24–25 despite the fact that the same students also became less likely to attend classes and graduate from high school. My results suggest that the opportunity cost of education is large for these students. (JEL H75, I21, I26, J24, J31, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用德克萨斯州公立学校学生总体的行政面板数据，我分析了当地经济状况冲击如何影响教育和就业决策。我发现，在学术能力分布底端的高中生在页岩气繁荣期间工作更多、收入更高，并且这些收入收益持续到24-25岁，尽管这些学生同时上课和高中毕业的可能性降低。我的结果表明，教育的机会成本对这些学生来说很大。（JEL H75, I21, I26, J24, J31, R23）

articles.abstract_en: Emigration of young, highly educated individuals may deprive origin countries of entrepreneurs. We identify exogenous variation in emigration from Italy by interacting past diaspora networks and current economic pull factors in destination countries. We find that a 1 standard deviation increase in the emigration rate generates a 4.8 percent decline in firms' creation in the local labor market of origin. An accounting exercise decomposes the estimated effect into four components: subtraction of individuals with average entrepreneurial propensity, selection of young and college-educated among emigrants, negative spillovers on firm creation, and selection on unobservable characteristics positively associated with entrepreneurship. (JEL F22, J23, J82, L26, M13, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 受过高等教育的年轻人移民可能会剥夺原籍国的企业家机会。我们通过过去的侨民网络和目的地国当前的经济拉动因素的相互作用来确定意大利移民的外生变化。我们发现，移民率1标准差的增加会导致原籍地劳动力市场的企业创造4.8%下降。会计工作将估计效果分解为四个组成部分：减去具有平均创业倾向的个人，在移民中选择受过大学教育的年轻人，对企业创建的负面溢出效应，以及选择与创业精神正相关的不可观察特征。 (JEL F22、J23、J82、L26、M13、R23)

articles.title_en: Are Small Firms Labor Constrained? Experimental Evidence from Ghana
articles.title_cn: 小企业是否受劳动力约束？来自加纳的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We report the results of a field experiment that randomly placed unemployed young people as apprentices with small firms in Ghana and included no cash subsidy to firms (or workers) beyond in-kind recruitment services. Treated firms experienced increases in firm size of approximately half a worker and firm profits of approximately 10 percent for each apprentice placement offered, documenting frictions to novice hiring. We interpret the program as providing a novel worker screening technology to firms, as (voluntary) worker participation included nonmonetary application costs, echoing the widespread use of an entrance fee mechanism for hiring apprentices in the existing labor market. (JEL D22, J13, J23, L25, M51, M53, O14)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们报告了一项实地实验的结果，该实验将失业青年随机安排为加纳小企业的学徒，且除实物招聘服务外，不向企业（或工人）提供现金补贴。处理组企业规模增加约半个工人，企业利润增加约10%，这是针对每个提供的学徒岗位，记录了新手招聘的摩擦。我们将该计划解释为向企业提供了一种新颖的工人筛选技术，因为（自愿）工人参与包括非货币申请成本，这与现有劳动力市场中广泛使用的学徒招聘入场费机制相呼应。（JEL D22, J13, J23, L25, M51, M53, O14）

articles.title_en: A New Spatial Hedonic Equilibrium in the Emerging Work-from-Home Economy?
articles.title_cn: 新兴居家办公经济中的新空间享乐均衡？
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the impacts of work from home (WFH) in the housing market from both intercity and intracity perspectives. Our results confirm the theoretical prediction that WFH puts downward pressure on housing prices and rents in high-productivity counties, a result of workers starting to relocate to cheaper metro areas during the pandemic without forsaking their desirable jobs. We also show that WFH tends to flatten intracity house-price gradients, weakening the price premium associated with good job access. (JEL J24, J31, J61, R21, R23, R31)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文从城市间和城市内两个视角研究了居家办公（WFH）对住房市场的影响。我们的结果证实了理论预测，即WFH对高生产率县的房价和租金产生下行压力，这是工人在疫情期间开始迁移到更便宜的大都市地区而不放弃其理想工作的结果。我们还表明，WFH倾向于使城市内房价梯度趋于平缓，削弱了与良好就业可达性相关的价格溢价。（JEL J24, J31, J61, R21, R23, R31）

articles.title_en: When Externalities Collide: Influenza and Pollution
articles.title_cn: 当外部性碰撞：流感与污染
articles.abstract_en: Influenza and air pollution each pose significant health risks with global economic consequences. Their shared etiological pathways present a case of compounding health risk via interacting externalities. Using instrumental variables based on changing wind direction, we show that increased levels of contemporaneous pollution increase influenza hospitalizations. We exploit random variation in effectiveness of the influenza vaccine as an additional instrument to show that vaccine protection neutralizes this relationship. Thus, pollution control and vaccination campaigns jointly provide greater returns than those implied by addressing either in isolation. We show the importance of this consideration in addressing observed gaps in influenza incidence by race. (JEL D62, I12, J15, Q51, Q53)
articles.abstract_cn: 流感和空气污染各自构成具有全球经济后果的重大健康风险。它们共同的病因学途径呈现了通过相互作用的外部性导致健康风险叠加的案例。利用基于风向变化的工具变量，我们表明同期污染水平的增加会增加流感住院率。我们利用流感疫苗有效性的随机变异作为额外工具，表明疫苗保护中和了这一关系。因此，污染控制和疫苗接种运动共同提供的回报大于单独处理任一问题所隐含的回报。我们展示了这一考虑在解决按种族划分的流感发病率观察差距中的重要性。(JEL D62, I12, J15, Q51, Q53)

articles.title_en: Tax Refund Uncertainty: Evidence and Welfare Implications
articles.title_cn: 退税不确定性：证据与福利影响
articles.abstract_en: Transfers paid through annual tax refunds are a large but uncertain source of income for poor households. We document that low-income tax filers have substantial subjective uncertainty about these refunds. We investigate the determinants and consequences of refund uncertainty by linking survey, tax, and credit bureau data. On average, filers' expectations track realized refunds. More uncertain filers have larger differences between expected and realized refunds. Filers borrow in anticipation of their refunds, but more uncertain filers borrow less, consistent with precautionary behavior. A simple consumption-savings model suggests that refund uncertainty reduces the welfare benefits of the EITC by about 10 percent. (JEL D81, D83, D84, G51, H24)
articles.abstract_cn: 通过年度退税支付的转移支付是贫困家庭一大但不确定的收入来源。我们记录了低收入报税者对这些退税存在相当大的主观不确定性。通过关联调查、税务和信用局数据，我们研究了退税不确定性的决定因素和后果。平均而言，报税者的预期与实际退税相符。更不确定的报税者其预期与实际退税之间的差异更大。报税者会预期退税而借款，但更不确定的报税者借款较少，这与预防性行为一致。一个简单的消费-储蓄模型表明，退税不确定性使EITC的福利收益减少了约10%。(JEL D81, D83, D84, G51, H24)

articles.title_en: Energy Saving May Kill: Evidence from the Fukushima Nuclear Accident
articles.title_cn: 节能可能致命：来自福岛核事故的证据
articles.abstract_en: Following the Fukushima nuclear accident, Japan gradually shut down all its nuclear power plants, causing a countrywide power shortage. In response the government launched large-scale energy-saving campaigns to reduce electricity consumption. Exploiting the electricity-saving targets across regions and over time, we show that the campaigns significantly increased mortality, particularly during extremely hot days. The impact is primarily driven by people using less air conditioning, as encouraged by the government. Nonpecuniary incentives can explain most of the reduction in electricity consumption. Our findings suggest there exists a trade-off between climate change mitigation and climate change adaptation. (JEL I12, L94, L98, Q48, Q54, Q58)
articles.abstract_cn: 福岛核事故后，日本逐步关闭了所有核电站，导致全国性电力短缺。作为回应，政府发起了大规模的节能运动以减少电力消耗。利用各地区和不同时期的节电目标，我们表明这些运动显著增加了死亡率，尤其是在极端炎热的日子里。这一影响主要由人们按照政府鼓励减少使用空调所驱动。非金钱激励可以解释电力消耗减少的大部分原因。我们的研究结果表明，在减缓气候变化和适应气候变化之间存在权衡。（JEL I12, L94, L98, Q48, Q54, Q58）
